name: AAdvantage Executive World Legend
effective_cost: High sticker fee, but Citi values the included Admirals Club membership at up to $1,400 a year, so this can be a net saver if you actually use the lounges
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment or a payment that's returned
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month, for Citi Flex Plan balances subject to a Plan Fee
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $10,000 in purchases in the first 3 months of account opening

verdict.text: Keep only if you fly American enough to use the Admirals Club

earn_rates.category: Hotels & car rentals, via AAdvantage portals

earn_note: A 5x rate kicks in on AA purchases for the rest of the calendar year once you cross $150,000 in total spend on the card that year. That threshold's realistically only relevant to very heavy spenders or small-business owners funneling large volume through the card. For everyone else it's 4x on AA, 12x on AAdvantage Hotels and Cars bookings, and 1x elsewhere; the case for this card is the Admirals Club, not the earn rate.

points.note: AAdvantage has used dynamic pricing with no published award chart since 2016, so value swings by route and date. No blackout dates on award redemptions, and for primary cardmembers miles don't expire as long as the card account is open.

transfer_partners.highlight: AAdvantage miles aren't a transferable bank-points currency, so there's no way to move them out to another loyalty program. Points can move in, though: Citi ThankYou Points transfer to American Airlines AAdvantage from the Strata cards.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: Citi became the sole issuer of AAdvantage-branded consumer credit cards as Barclays exited the co-brand partnership (announced Dec 2024, Barclays stopped issuing new AAdvantage cards Sept 30, 2025); Barclays AAdvantage cardholders began transitioning to equivalent Citi-issued cards starting April 2026, with some legacy Barclays benefits temporarily carried over.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
credits.subtitle: $120 · every 4 years
credits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee, once every four years. Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry, not just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and covers the same credit.

credits.name: Avis/Budget Credit
credits.subtitle: up to $120/yr
credits.description: Statement credits on eligible Avis or Budget car rentals, up to $120 per year.
tips: Only useful if you already rent from Avis/Budget specifically.

credits.name: Lyft Credit
credits.subtitle: $15/mo · up to $180/yr
credits.description: Up to $15 back per month on Lyft rides, after 3 qualifying rides in the month.
tips: Requires 3 Lyft rides in a month before the $15 credit triggers; an occasional Lyft user may not clear it most months.

credits.name: American Airlines Vacations Credit
credits.subtitle: $500 · calendar year
credits.description: Up to $500 in statement credits each calendar year on American Airlines Vacations packages.
tips: Only pays on a packaged AA Vacations booking, so it is worth nothing unless you were already buying flight-plus-hotel that way.

credits.name: Inflight & Admirals Club Credit
credits.subtitle: $100 · calendar year
credits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits each calendar year on inflight and Admirals Club purchases. This replaced the old uncapped 25% inflight rebate.
tips: Capped now, where the old rebate was not. Heavy inflight spenders come out worse than they did before the refresh.

credits.name: Grubhub Credit
credits.subtitle: $10/mo · up to $120/yr
credits.description: Withdrawn in the August 2026 refresh. It paid up to $10 back per month in Grubhub statement credits.
tips: Gone as of the World Legend refresh; the American Airlines Vacations and inflight credits replaced it.

credits.name: Dining Credits with inKind
credits.subtitle: $100 × 2 · Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec
credits.description: Up to $200 a year in dining credits with inKind when you add your eligible card to the inKind app: $100 usable January through June and $100 usable July through December.
tips: Only counts at restaurants on inKind, so check the app before relying on it.

insurance.detail: $500 per traveler, per trip · after 6 hrs
$3,000 per traveler, per trip ($2,000 per bag for NY residents), $10,000 per trip; checked bags only, no delay benefit listed

insurance.coverage: Rental car coverage (Worldwide Car Rental Insurance)
insurance.detail: Up to $75,000 · 31-day cap · secondary in the US, primary outside it

protection_note: Trip delay, trip cancellation/interruption, lost baggage, and worldwide rental car coverage are all included, a step up from Platinum Select and MileUp, which list none of this. Globe carries its own protection suite. The limits here come from Citi's Guide to Protection Benefits, effective July 23, 2023, the newest edition found.
rental_note: Worldwide Car Rental Insurance is included: up to $75,000 per rental, up to 31 consecutive days, secondary in the US and primary outside it. Pay for the whole rental with the card or AAdvantage miles and decline the rental company's collision waiver.

status_perks.name: Admirals Club membership
status_perks.note: Complimentary annual membership for the primary cardmember plus up to 2 guests or immediate family members, with unlimited visits to more than 100 Admirals Club lounges. Citi values it at up to $1,400 a year.

status_perks.name: Loyalty Points
status_perks.note: 1 Loyalty Point per eligible mile earned, plus a 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus at each of 50,000, 90,000, 165,000 and 240,000 Loyalty Points in a year, so 40,000 in total. A real boost toward AAdvantage status for heavy spenders.

services.name: Free first checked bag
services.detail: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines flights for the cardholder plus up to 8 companions on the same reservation, double Platinum Select's companion count.

services.name: No blackout dates
services.detail: Standard AAdvantage award redemption term across the whole card family.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

options.name: Authorized User
options.fee: $175 for up to 3, then $175 each additional

benefits.text: Admirals Club access at 18 or older, with immediate family or up to 2 guests; no partner lounges or full membership privileges
Earns AAdvantage miles on their spend (into your account)
Shares the Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit (same 4-year cycle)
No separate Loyalty Points allotment of their own

additional_cards.note: $175 covers up to three authorized users, and their spend earns miles into your account. Authorized users 18 or older get Admirals Club access and can bring immediate family or up to 2 guests, but not full membership privileges or partner lounges.

timeline.text: Citi added up to $200 a year in inKind dining credits, split into $100 for January through June and $100 for July through December.

The card is renamed the Citi / AAdvantage Executive World Legend Mastercard and the annual fee rises from $595 to $695, with a real refresh behind it. AAdvantage Hotels and Cars goes from 10x to 12x. The Loyalty Points bonus doubles from 20,000 to 40,000, restructured as 10,000 at each of four milestones (50,000, 90,000, 165,000, and 240,000 points a year) rather than two. Three credits are added or raised: up to $500/yr on American Airlines Vacations packages, up to $100/yr on inflight and Admirals Club purchases, and Lyft up from $120 to $180. Omni Hotels Champion status arrives with an annual free night after qualifying stays, plus Avis President's Club through Aug 31, 2028. Authorized users stay at $175 for up to three, then $175 each. The Grubhub credit went at the same time, and the uncapped 25% inflight rebate became the capped $100 credit. Existing cardholders get the new fee at their next anniversary.
Annual fee raised from $450 to $595 as part of Citi and American's broader refresh of the AAdvantage card lineup.

Citi became the sole issuer of AAdvantage-branded consumer credit cards as Barclays exited the partnership; transitioning Barclays cardholders began receiving Citi-issued cards in April 2026, with some legacy Barclays benefits temporarily carried over.
